title: Just Enough Optimizations and Utilities (JEOU)
description: A lightweight Fabric modpack focused on FPS, performance, and useful quality-of-life features.
body:
**Just Enough Optimizations and Utilities**


A lightweight Fabric modpack designed to maximize performance while keeping the vanilla Minecraft experience intact.

This pack combines some of the best optimization mods available for Minecraft 26.2, improving FPS, reducing memory usage, accelerating chunk generation, and decreasing loading times without changing core gameplay mechanics.

Included Features
- Significant FPS improvements
- Faster world generation and chunk loading
- Reduced RAM usage
- Better CPU and GPU utilization
- Improved game stability
- Vanilla-friendly experience
- Enhanced graphics settings through Sodium Extra

Main Optimization Mods

- Sodium
- Sodium Extra
- Lithium
- FerriteCore
- ModernFix
- ImmediatelyFast
- MoreCulling
- BadOptimizations
- C2ME
  
All credits for included mods belong to their respective authors.

If you encounter any issues or have suggestions, feel free to leave feedback.
